title: Establish ontology + decision-flow for hosted chat/streaming/tool-call/structured-output feature intake
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit a wide range of hosted API feature requests (chat, streaming, function/tool calling, structured output). Current intake is ad-hoc: PMs manually classify, engineering triage is inconsistent, and requests are often misrouted leading to delayed responses and missed SLAs.

Goal: Define a canonical ontology (request types, complexity tiers, security/privacy sensitivity, business priority signals) plus an operational decision-flow that automatically classifies and routes inbound hosted-API feature asks to the correct path (self-serve backlog, product spec, engineering spike, sales-assisted enterprise scoping, or legal/security review). Deliverables: ontology document, a decision-flow diagram, triage rubric, and a lightweight automation checklist (Zapier/Sheets or early webhook prototype) for the intake form.

Out of scope: Full automation into Jira/Linear; that will be follow-up once the rubric is validated.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical ontology doc published in Confluence (types, complexity tiers, security sensitivity definitions)
Decision-flow diagram with routing outcomes and SLA targets (e.g., initial ack within 24h, classification within 3 business days)
Triage rubric with scoring examples and at least 10 seeded customer requests mapped to outcomes
Pilot automation: incoming form responses are enriched with classification fields and routed to correct PM/eng inbox (manual webhook or Zapier)
Stakeholder signoff from Eng lead, Design lead, Sales engineering, and Legal on security-sensitive routing
tasks: Audit past 90 days of feature requests (Confluence intake, Zendesk, customer emails) and extract 100 representative examples
Design ontology draft (types: chat-feature, streaming-mode, tool-call integration, structured-output contract, infra/SLAs)
Work session with Eng (runtime + infra) to define complexity tiers and gating signals (KV cache impact, kernel changes, latency SLO risk)
Workshop with Sales/CS to capture enterprise signals (contract size, MSA requirements, audit needs)
Prototype decision-flow diagram and iterate with stakeholders (2 rounds)
Implement lightweight automation for intake enrichment and routing (Zapier or webhook + email routing)
Run 2-week pilot on new intake form and compare classification accuracy vs manual baseline
Document handoff and recommend next steps for Linear automation and metrics tracking

notes: Keep the ontology intentionally coarse for phase 1 (3-5 buckets) to maximize inter-rater reliability
Track false positives where a request classified as 'engineering spike' could have been satisfied by docs/quick-fix
Plan a 60-minute cross-functional review to finalize the rubric with examples
Consider exposing an internal dashboard with triage metrics (time-to-classify, routing accuracy, customer wait) in Console later
